points.name: Swift Run + Skyland
points.activity: Drilled two rock cores, Swift Run and Skyland, from the Skinner Ridge outcrop and sealed them in sample tubes. The material is sedimentary rock.
points.subtitle: Rock Core  ·  Sedimentary
points.details:
Samples 10 & 11  ·  Skinner Ridge outcrop, Fan Front
Sol 490 & 495  ·  Jul. 7&12, 2022  ·  sample length 6.1 cm

points.name: Atmo Mountain + Crosswind Lake
points.activity: Scooped two regolith samples (loose soil and pebbles), Atmo Mountain and Crosswind Lake, near Observation Mountain and sealed them in sample tubes. The material is likely mixed sedimentary and igneous grains.
points.subtitle: Regolith  ·  Likely mixed sedimentary and igneous grains
points.details:
Samples 17 & 18  ·  Observation Mountain outcrop, Fan Front
Sol 634 & 639  ·  Dec. 2&7, 2022  ·  sample length 6.7 cm

photos.caption: Front Hazcam: the robotic arm over the sand
